jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
The Technical Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for developing, supporting, and improving technology and business solutions that enable Clark Pacific’s business outcomes. This person works with IT team members, business groups, and vendors to help translate business needs into practical, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. This role contributes to application development, system integrations, reporting, data management, automation, and emerging AI-enabled solutions under the guidance of senior technical resources and IT leadership.

Competitive Compensation Range:
$47.16/hr. to $53.85/hr. depending on experience

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions.
Exercise a high level of professionalism and confidentiality when working with staff, projects, and proprietary information.
Develop, test, maintain, and support business applications and technical solutions.
Understand and extrapolate business needs and workflows and identify and recommend improved business processes and tools.
Build and maintain reusable services, APIs, scripts, and libraries that support business systems and integrations.
Build AI agents and/or other tools under the direction of the Senior Technical Solutions Engineer
Assist with the development and maintenance of data pipelines used to collect, transform, and store business data.
Support data models, reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions used by business teams.
Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to support automation, AI-enabled tools, and workflow improvements.
Troubleshoot and resolve application and performance issues.
Administer relational and non-relational databases
Provide input on effort, technical complexity, and risks for assigned work and project planning.
Other duties as assigned.

Key Interfaces

Internal
CIO
IT Department
Clark Pacific Business Teams

External
Technology Vendors

Key Metrics and Deliverables

Timeliness: Respond to business requests and questions within 24 hours. Provide weekly feedback on projects assigned. Maintain 80% adherence to schedule timelines.
Delivery: Solutions delivered on schedule with clear business value.
Quality: 90% achievement of quality goals.
Adoption: Business teams actively using and benefit from delivered solutions.
Policy / Procedures: 90% adherence to established IT policy and procedures including technology, security, network standards

Skills And Abilities

Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to understand business challenges and help develop practical technical solutions.
Working knowledge of current technology tools, platforms, and development practices.
Excellent communication skills; able to explain complex technical topics in plain language.
Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to complete assigned work with appropriate direction.
Ability to balance timely delivery with maintainability, security, and supportability.
Technical skills in software development, database administration, business intelligence, artificial intelligence tools, and systems integration.
Able to exercise appropriate discretion when handling confidential and/or sensitive information.

Work Environment

Primary work environments include Clark Pacific offices and manufacturing facilities.
There will be periodic exposure to manufacturing environments which may present hazards such as noise, electricity, chemicals, heavy equipment, and other automated and manual machinery.
There will be periodic exposure to outside weather conditions, including extreme cold and extreme heat, wet and/or humid environments.

Physical Demands

Frequent: Sitting at desk, utilizing computers and phones, standing and walking
Periodic: Repetitive foot, leg, hand, arm, shoulder, and torso movements
Occasional: Business travel (10%). Bending squatting, stooping, reaching, pushing, pulling, and lifting

Experience And Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent required.
4+ years’ experience in application development, database administration, data integrations, or related technical work in business environments.
Hands-on experience with one or more common programming languages, such as Python, JavaScript, .NET, C#, or VB.NET, is required.
Experience working with relational databases, including Microsoft SQL Server or MySQL, is required.
Experience supporting or maintaining system integrations using APIs, file transfers, or event-based processes.
Experience using, extending, and configuring the Microsoft Productivity Stack (Teams, SharePoint, Office 365, Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI, Copilot) is required.
Practical experience with data pipelines, analytics tools, AI-enabled tools, or automation solutions is preferred.
Working understanding of cloud platforms, Azure preferred, including compute, storage, and security concepts.
Experience with construction tools including Autodesk Construction Cloud,
Tekla, Viewpoint, Bluebeam and other applications used in manufacturing and construction are strongly preferred.

Core Values

Determination:
Meet challenges head on!

Innovation:
Always look for better!

Well-Being:
Seek the success, health and happiness of all!

Benefits

Competitive compensation, paid on a weekly basis.
Health, Dental and Vision Insurance with the options of using Kaiser and VSP for vision!
Medical FSA
Dependent Care FSA
Employer paid life insurance provided by Clark Pacific
Voluntary ancillary benefits such as Critical Illness, Accident Insurance, and Whole Life Insurance.
401(k) matching 100% of the first 3%, then 50% of the next 2%.

Benefits subject to waiting period.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems LLC is looking for an enthusiastic, well-qualified individual to fill the Data Analyst position. This role offers the opportunity to work with a diverse and talented group of individuals committed to driving success.

The ideal candidate is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and managing system and project data to support Tech Refresh operations, data-driven decision-making, and process improvement initiatives.

The Data Analyst provides actionable insights, automation recommendations, and project status reporting to support current and future growth. This position plays a key role in ensuring Tech Refresh schedules, asset execution, and implementation activities are supported by accurate, timely, and well-structured data.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst will

Support Tech Refresh data analysis activities across DIA systems and sites within contract scope
Collect, analyze, and maintain system, asset, and project data related to Tech Refresh operations
Provide process improvement and automation recommendations to enhance Tech Refresh execution and data management
Develop and maintain project data, dashboards, reports, and status updates to track schedule, implementation, and asset execution
Prepare and define data requirements supporting Tech Refresh utilization, planning, and execution
Analyze trends and performance metrics to support project success and future enterprise growth
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reporting artifacts
Collaborate with technical, operational, and leadership teams to translate requirements into data-driven solutions
Support planning and scalability efforts for future DIA and Defense Intelligence Enterprise sites
Document data sources, methodologies, and analytical processes

Skills And Experience

The Data Analyst must have

Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
10+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, data management, data engineering, or related disciplines supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, or Federal programs
Demonstrated experience collecting, acquiring, extracting, integrating, inspecting, cleansing, validating, and managing data from multiple structured and unstructured sources
Strong knowledge of data analysis, data management principles, and data lifecycle processes
Experience or working knowledge of data engineering principles, data science methodologies, and process automation and optimization techniques
Proven ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) or Intelligence Community (IC) programs
Familiarity with enterprise IT modernization, technology refresh (Tech Refresh), or digital transformation initiatives
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple data sources, priorities, and deliverables in a dynamic environment

Education and Certifications

The Data Analyst must meet the following

Required

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Relevant experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree

Preferred

CompTIA Security+ CE
CompTIA Data+
Certified Data Analyst (vendor-neutral or platform-specific)
Microsoft, AWS, or other analytics-related certifications

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k)
PTO
Paid Parental Leave
Tuition reimbursement
Paid federal holidays

Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Company Summary

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

Company Employment Statement

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing as positions, functions, and qualifications may vary depending on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, or Vietnam era, or other eligible veteran status or legally protected characteristics.

USD $115,000.00 - USD $125,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.description:
Benefits:

401(k)
Bonus based on performance
Competitive salary
Dental insurance
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Profit sharing
Vision insurance

HETI has a great opportunity for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Senior Engineer with 10+ years’ experience in the environmental field.

This role will be responsible for providing technical and business skills and contribute to advanced solutions in the environmental, chemical, commercial, manufacturing, government, energy, financial, insurance, and/or legal sectors. This job is 100% remote.

The candidate should have experience managing consulting assignments, must work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, is expected to be proficient in the analysis and communication of information, and must be able to work cooperatively with agencies, organizations, and individuals to guide decision-making. The successful candidate is also expected to be proficient in all facets of project management. He/she must demonstrate collaboration with colleagues throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Client Management & Communication:

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and outcomes.
Collaborate with project teams, including environmental engineers, geologists, and technicians.
Communicate complex technical information to clients and stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting:

Interact and coordinate with regulatory agencies to obtain necessary approvals, permits, and closure documentation.
Prepare and submit comprehensive reports, including site investigation reports, risk assessment reports, remedial action plans, progress reports, and closure reports.
Be current and continue to be current on environmental regulations and guidelines.

Remediation Planning/Implementation:

Develop and implement effective remediation plans based on the findings of site investigations and risk assessments.
Design and oversee the implementation of remediation strategies, which may include excavation, soil vapor extraction, groundwater treatment, in-situ bioremediation, or other appropriate methods.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and permits during the remediation process.

Insurance Claim Support

Experience providing technical support to insurance claims professionals for environmental or energy related claims.
Understanding of insurance terminology and policy language.
Experience in assessing the source and timing of pollution events.
Diverse environmental consulting experience.
Excellent technical writing skills.

Site Assessments:

Manage/conduct comprehensive site investigations to identify potential sources of contamination, evaluate risks, and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
Collect soil, groundwater, and other environmental samples and analyze them in accordance with standard protocols and regulations.
Perform data interpretation, risk assessment, and modeling to determine the extent and nature of contamination and its potential impact on human health and the environment.

Quality Control:

Implement quality control and assurance measures to ensure accurate and reliable data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Conduct periodic audits and reviews of project activities to verify compliance with project plans and regulations.
Identify and address any deviations or discrepancies in project execution promptly.

The Ideal Candidate should have:

Current PE or PG license
Bachelor’s Degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or a related field.
10+ years’ experience conducting site investigations remediation and third party evaluations
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, guidelines, and best practices related to contaminated site cleanup.
Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, and project teams.
Attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of environmental sampling techniques and laboratory analysis methods.

Founded in 1986, HETI is a full-service, nationwide environmental services company specializing in environmental and indoor air quality site assessment, site remediation, risk characterization, occupational health and safety services, and litigation/expert witness support. Through our network of offices throughout the U.S., we serve a variety of large and small businesses.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and offer a competitive benefit package including base salary plus bonus opportunities and a friendly, flexible work environment.

Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Expert Opportunity - Biologist / Environmental Scientist ($90/hr, up to $1,800/week)
jobs.description:
About This Opportunity

We're working with a leading foundational AI lab to find experienced biologists and environmental scientists who can help train their latest language model on professional document, spreadsheet, and slide deck tasks.

We're looking for biology and environmental science professionals with 4+ years in ecological research, environmental consulting, or applied biology to create, evaluate, and refine AI-generated documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks across core workflows: environmental impact assessment reports, species habitat and biodiversity survey summaries, water and soil quality monitoring data sheets, regulatory permit and compliance submissions, field study methodology and sampling protocols, and conservation and remediation project proposals.

Compensation:
$90/hour

Commitment:
Flexible, 5-20 hours per week (or more if desired)

Location:
Fully remote, work on your own schedule

Start date:
ASAP

Qualifications

4+ years conducting environmental impact assessments, ecological surveys, or regulatory compliance monitoring in a consulting, government, or academic setting
Direct experience interpreting field and lab data such as species counts, water and soil chemistry, or emissions readings and translating it into technical reports for regulators or clients
Expert-level document, spreadsheet, and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail

About Ethos

Ethos is a new expert network built by a McKinsey/SoftBank/DeepMind team and backed by world-leading investors like General Catalyst. We connect experts with investors and consultancies for paid expert calls, speaking engagements, and advisory opportunities.

4+ years conducting environmental impact assessments, ecological surveys, or regulatory compliance monitoring in a consulting, government, or academic setting
Direct experience interpreting field and lab data such as species counts, water and soil chemistry, or emissions readings and translating it into technical reports for regulators or clients
Expert-level document, spreadsheet, and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail

jobs.title: Data Analyst II (Enterprise)
jobs.description:
About The Company

First Citizens Bank is a premier financial institution dedicated to providing exceptional banking services to individuals, businesses, and communities across the United States. With a rich history of stability, integrity, and innovation, the bank has established itself as a trusted partner in financial growth and stability. Committed to fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technological advancement, First Citizens Bank leverages cutting-edge data management and analytics to deliver personalized solutions and strategic insights. The organization values diversity, inclusion, and professional development, ensuring a collaborative environment where employees can thrive and contribute to the bank’s mission of empowering its clients and communities.

About The Role

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following locations: Charlotte, NC, Raleigh, NC, or Phoenix, AZ. The position is a key member of the Enterprise Data organization, focusing on the governance, architecture, and management of enterprise-wide data assets. The successful candidate will support initiatives aimed at enhancing data quality, strengthening governance frameworks, and advancing analytics capabilities within the bank. This role involves driving technical innovation, facilitating continuous improvement initiatives, and creating comprehensive technical documentation related to enterprise data systems. The individual will serve as an expert consultant, providing guidance to team members, IT departments, and other stakeholders to achieve data management objectives effectively. The role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for data enhancement, ensuring compliance with data policies, and supporting business strategies through robust data solutions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Data Management, Computer Science, Finance, or related field and 4 years of relevant experience, or
High School Diploma or GED with 8 years of extensive experience in Data Management, Financial Analysis, or similar roles.
Understanding of data warehousing, transformation, and ETL processes.
Knowledge of emerging technologies impacting the financial services and insurance industries.
Experience with banking, regulatory compliance, Data Warehouses/Data Lakes, AWS, Snowflake, and related cloud technologies.
Proven track record of leading agile data product delivery across cross-functional teams utilizing frameworks such as Scrum, SAFe, or Kanban.
Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data analysis.
Ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using Tableau and Power BI.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Responsibilities

Identify and implement enhancements to improve the quality, management, and storage of enterprise data assets.
Execute initiatives to improve data profiling, exception reporting, and issue resolution within the Enterprise Data Warehouse.
Build and maintain dashboards to support modern analytics and reporting needs.
Enforce data policies and procedures across the organization to ensure compliance and data integrity.
Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and identify opportunities for improving data management capabilities.
Perform month-end data validations to ensure the accuracy and completeness of reporting data prior to business use.
Facilitate initiatives to develop and enhance the bank’s data management capabilities and infrastructure.
Assist management in creating and executing business plans aligned with data-driven objectives.
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, and lineage.
Stay informed on current and emerging data technologies and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.

Benefits

Competitive salary packages aligned with industry standards.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans.
Retirement savings plans including 401(k) options with company matching.
Paid time off and holidays to support work-life balance.
Professional development opportunities and continuous learning programs.
Flexible remote work arrangements within specified locations.
Employee assistance programs and wellness initiatives.
Access to cutting-edge tools and technologies to support your role.

Equal Opportunity

First Citizens Bank is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
